text.title: 服务室门口的两张卡
text.situation:
5月29日周六，玛雅又来到中心，赴上午九点半的预约。会议桌再往里，服务室门外立着两张姓名卡。一张介绍来访的医师，另一张介绍在房间另一处工作的治疗师。玛雅预约的是一次咨询，不是按摩；她对照预约卡确认了自己的名字。进门后，医师把一份传单放在桌上。传单介绍为长期患有某种疾病的人提供的支持，并列出了他们可以带到预约中询问的问题。玛雅问，关于已有病历的问题该由谁处理。医师指了指第一张卡。透过半开的门，她看见有人正把干净毛巾轻轻摆在椅子上。

服务室——5月29日周六
医师：在靠门的桌旁接待已预约的咨询。
治疗师：在屏风旁另行接待预约，服务项目包括按摩。
进门前请核对预约卡上的姓名。如果带来了信件或已有病历，请告诉接待你这次预约的人员。

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, 29 May, Maya returned to the centre for her 9.30 appointment. Beyond the meeting table, two name cards stood outside the service room. One introduced the visiting medical practitioner; the other introduced a therapist working in a different part of the room. Maya had booked a conversation, not a massage, and checked her name against the appointment card. Inside, the practitioner placed a leaflet on the desk. It described support for people living with a long-term disorder and listed questions they could bring to an appointment. Maya asked who would deal with a question about an existing medical record. The practitioner pointed to the first card. Through the partly open door, someone was quietly arranging clean towels on a chair.

paragraphs.en:
SERVICE ROOM — SATURDAY, 29 MAY
Medical practitioner: booked consultations at the desk nearest the door.
Therapist: separate appointments beside the screened area. The service list includes massage.
Please check the name on your appointment card before entering. If you have brought a letter or an existing medical record, tell the person handling your appointment.

S11.D16.P01.function: Two cards at the service-room door
S11.D16.P01.cue: 朋友看到两张姓名卡，不知道它们是不是同一种角色。按卡上的介绍说说谁是谁。
acceptableAnswers: 一张卡介绍医师，另一张介绍治疗师。

S11.D16.P02.function: Two cards at the service-room door
S11.D16.P02.cue: 工作人员问玛雅预约了什么。说明她来咨询，并非预约按摩。
acceptableAnswers: 玛雅预约的是与医师咨询，不是按摩。

S11.D16.P03.function: Two cards at the service-room door
S11.D16.P03.cue: 朋友没看过桌上的传单。告诉他传单为哪些人介绍支持，也列了些什么。
acceptableAnswers: 传单介绍了为长期患有某种疾病的人提供的支持，以及预约时可以问的问题。

S11.D16.T01.function: Two cards at the service-room door
S11.D16.T01.cue: 另一家诊所的短信只写了治疗师预约，你不清楚对方的角色。问问接待处这次约见的是谁。
acceptableAnswers: 我这次预约是见治疗师还是医师？
